class QueryCompetitionIndicator(nn.Module):
    """Predict confidence from a query and its overlapping competitors."""

    def __init__(self, d_model):
        super().__init__()
        self.query_norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
        self.evidence_norm = nn.LayerNorm(3 * d_model + 1)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(3 * d_model + 1, d_model),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(d_model, d_model),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(d_model, 2),
        )

    def forward(self, query, pred_masks, batch_mask, point_mass):
        valid = (~batch_mask).unsqueeze(1).to(pred_masks.dtype)
        probabilities = pred_masks.sigmoid() * valid
        weighted = probabilities * point_mass.unsqueeze(1)
        areas = weighted.sum(-1)
        intersection = torch.einsum(
            'bim,bjm->bij', weighted, probabilities
        )
        union = areas.unsqueeze(-1) + areas.unsqueeze(1) - intersection
        overlap = intersection / union.clamp_min(1e-6)
        diagonal = torch.eye(
            overlap.shape[-1], dtype=torch.bool, device=overlap.device
        ).unsqueeze(0)
        overlap = overlap.masked_fill(diagonal, 0.0)

        competition = overlap / overlap.sum(-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-6)
        normalized_query = self.query_norm(query)
        context = torch.einsum('bij,bjd->bid', competition, normalized_query)
        max_overlap = overlap.max(-1).values.unsqueeze(-1)
        evidence = torch.cat(
            [
                normalized_query,
                context,
                normalized_query - context,
                max_overlap,
            ],
            dim=-1,
        )
        return self.head(self.evidence_norm(evidence))
